items.claim: Maersk meddelte at have gennemfoert den foerste kommercielle ship-to-ship-bunkring med ethanol af et deep-sea containerskib i USA, og Ditlev Blicher, Regional President for North America, sagde: "Achieving lower-emission logistics requires turning new technologies into practical, scalable solutions."
items.source: Ditlev Blicher, Maersk Regional President North America, i Maersks egen meddelelse

items.claim: Maersk meddelte en udvidelse af samarbejdet med PUMA, hvor Maersk overtager driften af PUMAs nordamerikanske distributionsnetvaerk, og Dave Hune, North America Head of Maersk Contract Logistics, sagde: "This partnership is a great example of how Maersk can combine our operational expertise, technology, and logistics network with a customer's existing assets to improve efficiency."
items.source: Dave Hune, North America Head of Maersk Contract Logistics, i Maersks egen meddelelse (PUMAs Helmut Leibbrandt citeres ligeledes)
